attribution.note: Marcus states and endorses the claim in his own words.

semantics.note: The statement attributes worse factual grounding to restricting synthesis to X posts. The surrounding context preserves the exclusion of original sources.

contract.note: Lower factual accuracy is a fair plain reading. Comparing otherwise comparable synthesis with and without the restriction reasonably operationalizes the implied baseline, although Marcus supplies no measure.

evidence.note: Dated reporting establishes the announced source restriction through company statements. It neither independently audits implementation nor demonstrates an accuracy effect.
Documents factual errors, but provides no matched comparison or relative error rate establishing deterioration caused by the restriction.
Available before the cutoff, but evaluates systems with web search enabled. Neither its cross-system comparison nor its no-search ablation isolates X-only synthesis.

reviews.rationale: The packet establishes an announced restriction and examples of errors, but contains no verified comparison isolating the restriction's effect on factual accuracy. It therefore establishes neither the claimed deterioration nor its absence.
